sect1.title: Introduction
sect1.para: The TopKinematics class, implemented in Cython, is a specialized selection template within the AnalysisG framework, designed for comprehensive analysis of top quark kinematics in Monte Carlo 20 (MC20) events. It inherits from the generic SelectionTemplate class, extending its functionalities to extract and organize detailed information about resonant and spectator top quark kinematics, as well as mass and Delta-R (dR) combinations. This class facilitates a high-performance extraction and structuring of top quark kinematic data for further physics analysis in the MC20 context.

sect1.title: The TopKinematics Class
sect1.para: TopKinematics is a cdef class, indicating its implementation as a Cython extension type. It inherits from SelectionTemplate, thereby gaining all the base functionalities for event selection, ROOT file interpretation, and weight management. Its primary role is to encapsulate a C++ topkinematics object, which likely contains the logic for calculating and storing top quark kinematic properties.

listitem.para: __cinit__(self): The Cython "constructor" equivalent, called during object allocation. It initializes a new C++ topkinematics object and assigns its pointer to self.ptr. It then upcasts self.ptr to a topkinematics* and assigns it to self.tt for specialized access.
__init__(self): (Not explicitly defined in the provided snippet) This would typically be the Python initializer.
__dealloc__(self): The Cython "destructor" equivalent, called upon object deallocation. It deallocates the C++ topkinematics object pointed to by self.tt, ensuring proper memory management.

cdef void transform_dict_keys(self): This method is responsible for converting the C++ data structures within the underlying topkinematics object into Python dictionaries, making them accessible as properties of the TopKinematics instance.
self.res_top_kinematics: Populated from self.tt.res_top_kinematics (kinematics of resonant top quarks).
self.spec_top_kinematics: Populated from self.tt.spec_top_kinematics (kinematics of spectator top quarks).
self.mass_combi: Populated from self.tt.mass_combi (mass combinations).
self.deltaR: Populated from self.tt.deltaR (Delta-R combinations).

sect1.title: C++ Interaction
sect1.para:
The TopKinematics class leverages Cython's capabilities for seamless C++ integration:
cdef class TopKinematics: Declares TopKinematics as a Cython extension type.
cdef topkinematics *tt: A C++ pointer to a topkinematics object, which is the specialized C++ implementation for top quark kinematic analysis.
self.ptr = new topkinematics(): Initializes the base SelectionTemplate's C++ pointer.
self.tt = <topkinematics*>self.ptr: This line demonstrates C++ upcasting, allowing TopKinematics to fulfill the SelectionTemplate interface while internally managing its specific topkinematics data.
from AnalysisG.core.selection_template cimport SelectionTemplate: Imports the base SelectionTemplate class, from which TopKinematics inherits.
from AnalysisG.core.tools cimport as_dict: Imports utility functions for converting between C++ and Python data structures.
